blocks.text: The Zscaler and Silverfort Deployment Guide provides instructions on using Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) features with the Silverfort Unified Identity Protection Platform.

Silverfort’s Unified Identity Protection Platform enables secure authentication and access for any sensitive corporate system, both on-premises and in the cloud, without requiring any agents or proxies.

The Zscaler Adaptive Access Engine receives user risk signals from Silverfort, which can control user access to applications via Zscaler. You can configure the Silverfort settings and establish the connection between Silverfort and Adaptive Access Engine. Silverfort shares the context signals (User Risk Level) with the Adaptive Access Engine.
